{
  "name": "claude-mem",
  "version": "15.11.0",
  "description": "Memory compression system for Claude Code - persist context across sessions",
  "keywords": [
    "claude",
    "claude-code",
    "claude-agent-sdk",
    "mcp",
    "plugin",
    "memory",
    "compression",
    "knowledge-graph",
    "transcript",
    "typescript",
    "nodejs"
  ],
  "author": "Alex Newman",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem.git"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem#readme",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/issues"
  },
  "type": "module",
  "bin": {
    "claude-mem": "./dist/npx-cli/index.js"
  },
  "exports": {
    "./modes/*": "./plugin/modes/*"
  },
  "files": [
    "dist",
    ".agents/plugins/marketplace.json",
    ".claude-plugin",
    ".codex-plugin",
    ".qoder-plugin",
    "plugin/.claude-plugin",
    "plugin/.codex-plugin",
    "plugin/.qoder-plugin",
    "plugin/.mcp.json",
    "plugin/qoder.mcp.json",
    "plugin/package.json",
    "plugin/bun.lock",
    "plugin/hooks",
    "plugin/modes",
    "plugin/scripts/*.js",
    "plugin/scripts/*.cjs",
    "plugin/scripts/*.map",
    "plugin/sqlite",
    "plugin/skills",
    "plugin/ui",
    "openclaw",
    "omp",
    "hermes",
    "ods/README.md",
    "ods/install.mjs",
    "ods/native",
    "ods/patches",
    "ods/service",
    "pi",
    "dsh",
    "NOTICE"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": "^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0",
    "bun": ">=1.1.31"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "npm run build-and-sync",
    "build": "node scripts/sync-plugin-manifests.js && node scripts/build-hooks.js && node scripts/gen-plugin-lockfile.cjs",
    "build-and-sync": "npm run build && npm run sync-marketplace && node scripts/restart-marketplace-worker.cjs",
    "sync-marketplace": "node scripts/sync-marketplace.cjs",
    "sync-marketplace:force": "node scripts/sync-marketplace.cjs --force",
    "build:binaries": "node scripts/build-worker-binary.js",
    "build:cli-binary": "bun build --compile --minify --entry-naming \"[name].js\" ./src/services/worker-service.ts ./src/services/context/context-read-worker.ts ./src/services/work-view/work-view-read-worker.ts --outfile plugin/scripts/claude-mem",
    "worker:logs": "node scripts/worker-logs.cjs",
    "worker:tail": "node scripts/worker-logs.cjs --follow",
    "changelog:generate": "node scripts/generate-changelog.js",
    "worker:start": "bun plugin/scripts/worker-service.cjs start",
    "worker:stop": "bun plugin/scripts/worker-service.cjs stop",
    "worker:restart": "bun plugin/scripts/worker-service.cjs restart",
    "worker:status": "bun plugin/scripts/worker-service.cjs status",
    "queue": "bun scripts/check-pending-queue.ts",
    "queue:process": "bun scripts/check-pending-queue.ts --process",
    "claude-md:regenerate": "bun scripts/regenerate-claude-md.ts",
    "claude-md:dry-run": "bun scripts/regenerate-claude-md.ts --dry-run",
    "strip-comments": "bun scripts/strip-comments.ts",
    "strip-comments:check": "bun scripts/strip-comments.ts --check",
    "strip-comments:dry-run": "bun scripts/strip-comments.ts --dry-run",
    "translate-readme": "bun scripts/translate-readme/cli.ts -v -o docs/i18n README.md",
    "translate:tier1": "npm run translate-readme -- zh zh-tw ja pt pt-br ko es de fr",
    "translate:tier2": "npm run translate-readme -- he ar ru pl cs nl tr uk",
    "translate:tier3": "npm run translate-readme -- vi tl id th hi bn ur ro sv",
    "translate:tier4": "npm run translate-readme -- it el hu fi da no",
    "translate:all": "npm run translate:tier1 & npm run translate:tier2 & npm run translate:tier3 & npm run translate:tier4 & wait",
    "bug-report": "node dist/bug-report/index.js",
    "cursor:install": "bun plugin/scripts/worker-service.cjs cursor install",
    "cursor:uninstall": "bun plugin/scripts/worker-service.cjs cursor uninstall",
    "cursor:status": "bun plugin/scripts/worker-service.cjs cursor status",
    "cursor:setup": "bun plugin/scripts/worker-service.cjs cursor setup",
    "lint:hook-io": "node scripts/check-hook-io-discipline.cjs",
    "lint:spawn-env": "node scripts/check-spawn-env-discipline.cjs",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p src/ui/viewer/tsconfig.json",
    "typecheck:root": "tsc --noEmit",
    "typecheck:viewer": "tsc --noEmit -p src/ui/viewer/tsconfig.json",
    "test": "bun scripts/test-lanes.ts fast",
    "test:integration": "bun scripts/test-lanes.ts integration",
    "test:all": "bun scripts/test-lanes.ts all",
    "test:lanes:check": "bun scripts/test-lanes.ts check",
    "test:sqlite": "bun test tests/sqlite/",
    "test:agents": "bun test tests/worker/agents/",
    "test:search": "bun test tests/worker/search/",
    "test:context": "bun test tests/context/",
    "test:infra": "bun test tests/infrastructure/",
    "test:server": "bun test tests/server/",
    "e2e:server:docker": "bash scripts/e2e-server-docker.sh",
    "e2e:sync-matrix": "bun scripts/sync-matrix-e2e.ts",
    "eval:read-gate": "bun scripts/eval-read-gate.ts",
    "check:postinstall-allowlist": "node scripts/check-postinstall-allowlist.js",
    "smoke:clean-room": "node scripts/smoke-clean-room.cjs",
    "prepublishOnly": "npm run build && node scripts/check-postinstall-allowlist.js",
    "test:media-converter": "bun test tests/media/converter.test.ts",
    "smoke:media-binary": "node scripts/smoke-media-binary.cjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@better-auth/api-key": "^1.6.16",
    "better-auth": "^1.6.16",
    "sharp": "0.35.5"
  },
  "//dependencies-note": "Sharp is the native media decoder, externalized and lazy-loaded only by media conversion. Only deps that survive the bundler as a live `import`/`require` in a shipped artifact live here — better-auth (+ api-key) is the server-runtime auth surface, externalized from the worker bundle deliberately (see scripts/build-hooks.js). @huggingface/transformers, the server's embedder, is a devDependency here: LocalEmbedder loads it by dynamic import, the server bundle keeps it external along with its onnxruntime-node and sharp, and a server resolves it from plugin/package.json's optional dependencies (see scripts/build-hooks.js), never from this package. Everything else (express, bullmq, ioredis, react, react-dom, dompurify, @clack/prompts, ansi-to-html, posthog-node, shell-quote, pg, zod, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk) is esbuild-inlined into the worker/server/npx bundles (the worker and MCP server inline zod too; the other plugin bundles still resolve zod from plugin/package.json's own dependency), so it is a build-time devDependency and is not downloaded by consumers of the `claude-mem` package.",
  "overrides": {
    "tmp": "^0.2.7",
    "onnxruntime-node": "1.23.2",
    "onnxruntime-web": "npm:onnxruntime-common@1.23.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@huggingface/transformers": "^4.2.0",
    "@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk": "^0.3.172",
    "@clack/prompts": "^1.3.0",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.29.0",
    "ansi-to-html": "^0.7.2",
    "bullmq": "^5.76.6",
    "dompurify": "^3.4.9",
    "express": "^5.2.1",
    "ioredis": "^5.10.1",
    "pg": "^8.20.0",
    "posthog-node": "^5.36.15",
    "react": "^19.2.6",
    "react-dom": "^19.2.6",
    "shell-quote": "1.9.0",
    "zod": "^4.4.3",
    "@derekstride/tree-sitter-sql": "^0.3.11",
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-lua": "^0.4.1",
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-markdown": "^0.3.2",
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-toml": "^0.7.0",
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml": "^0.7.1",
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-zig": "^1.1.2",
    "@types/bun": "^1.3.13",
    "@types/express": "^5.0.6",
    "@types/node": "^25.9.2",
    "@types/pg": "^8.20.0",
    "@types/react": "^19.2.17",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.2.3",
    "esbuild": "^0.28.0",
    "parse5": "^8.0.1",
    "postcss": "^8.5.14",
    "remark-mdx": "^3.1.1",
    "remark-parse": "^11.0.0",
    "tree-sitter-bash": "^0.25.1",
    "tree-sitter-c": "^0.24.1",
    "tree-sitter-cli": "^0.26.8",
    "tree-sitter-cpp": "^0.23.4",
    "tree-sitter-css": "^0.25.0",
    "tree-sitter-go": "^0.25.0",
    "tree-sitter-haskell": "^0.23.1",
    "tree-sitter-java": "^0.23.5",
    "tree-sitter-javascript": "^0.25.0",
    "tree-sitter-kotlin": "^0.3.8",
    "tree-sitter-php": "^0.24.2",
    "tree-sitter-python": "^0.25.0",
    "tree-sitter-ruby": "^0.23.1",
    "tree-sitter-rust": "^0.24.0",
    "tree-sitter-scala": "^0.24.0",
    "tree-sitter-scss": "^1.0.0",
    "tree-sitter-swift": "^0.7.1",
    "tree-sitter-typescript": "^0.23.2",
    "typescript": "^6.0.3",
    "unified": "^11.0.5",
    "unist-util-visit": "^5.1.0",
    "typebox": "1.1.24"
  },
  "trustedDependencies": [
    "esbuild",
    "tree-sitter-c",
    "tree-sitter-cli",
    "tree-sitter-cpp",
    "tree-sitter-go",
    "tree-sitter-java",
    "tree-sitter-javascript",
    "tree-sitter-python",
    "tree-sitter-ruby",
    "tree-sitter-rust",
    "tree-sitter-typescript"
  ],
  "allowScripts": {
    "tree-sitter-cli": true,
    "tree-sitter": true,
    "tree-sitter-c": true,
    "tree-sitter-cpp": true,
    "tree-sitter-go": true,
    "tree-sitter-java": true,
    "tree-sitter-javascript": true,
    "tree-sitter-python": true,
    "tree-sitter-ruby": true,
    "tree-sitter-rust": true,
    "tree-sitter-typescript": true,
    "tree-sitter-kotlin": true,
    "tree-sitter-swift": true,
    "tree-sitter-php": true,
    "tree-sitter-scala": true,
    "tree-sitter-bash": true,
    "tree-sitter-haskell": true,
    "tree-sitter-css": true,
    "tree-sitter-scss": true,
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-lua": true,
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-zig": true,
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-toml": true,
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml": true,
    "@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-markdown": true,
    "@derekstride/tree-sitter-sql": true,
    "esbuild": true,
    "@biomejs/biome": true,
    "better-sqlite3": true
  }
}
